bat_01.name: Lesser Spirit Bat
bat_01.behaviorDescription: Fast and erratic. They tend to swarm in large numbers, making them difficult to target without area-of-effect spells.

zombie_01.name: Corpse Wight
zombie_01.behaviorDescription: Slow but resilient. These animated corpses possess high health and can deal significant damage if they manage to corner you.

guard_01.name: Ghostly Sentinel
guard_01.behaviorDescription: A balanced and dangerous guardian. Sentinels are faster than wights and far deadlier, often protecting valuable spirit veins.

archer_01.name: Spectral Archer
archer_01.behaviorDescription: A ranged attacker that keeps its distance and fires spirit arrows.
